title: 3D Printed Nasopharyngeal Swabs with Wrapped Rayon Fibers
author: Justin Ryan
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bemxjc7n

steps.title: Load and prepare 3D print file
steps.instruction: Wear gloves, open the supplied 3D print file SCREEEN_NPSwab_Rev56 (1).stl, note that it is designed to not need support structures (add supports only if your printer benefits), and do not use adhesives on the build bed unless validated.

substeps.instruction: Wear gloves and open the supplied 3D print file SCREEEN_NPSwab_Rev56 (1).stl
Confirm the file requires no support structures; add supports only if the printer benefits
Do not apply adhesives to the build bed unless further validation has been performed

steps.title: Print swab design in nylon
steps.instruction: Print the SCREEN design using a nylon‑based material; do not add any additional adhesives or binding agents unless they have been validated.

substeps.instruction: Print the SCREEN design using nylon‑based media
Avoid using adhesives or binding agents unless they have been validated

steps.title: Inspect printed swabs for defects
steps.instruction: After printing, examine each swab for deviations such as delamination and burrs.

steps.title: Prepare rayon fibers
steps.instruction: Take a quarter‑sized amount of rayon fibers.

steps.title: Wrap rayon fibers onto tip
steps.instruction: Tightly wrap the rayon fibers around the tip of the swab, ensuring the end of the tip is fully covered; using a non‑white print media helps visualize any exposed regions.

substeps.instruction: Tightly wrap fibers onto the tip, covering the tip end completely
Use non‑white print media to see any exposed regions

steps.title: Adjust swab tip diameter
steps.instruction: Ensure the wrapped tip diameter is 3–4 mm; remove excess rayon or add more to achieve this size.

steps.title: Intertwine fibers with non‑radial motions
steps.instruction: Perform non‑radial motions to help the fibers intertwine and reduce the chance of unwinding.

steps.title: Pull to secure fibers
steps.instruction: Pull on the collective rayon fibers to confirm they are not dislodged; if any fibers detach, re‑wrap tighter.

steps.title: Sterilize swabs by high‑level decontamination
steps.instruction: Package each swab individually with a temperature indicator and sterilize at 270 °F for 4 minutes (high‑level decontamination). Prototypes were also autoclaved at 121 °C for 20 minutes without complications.

substeps.instruction: Package each swab individually with a temperature indicator
Note alternative autoclave condition: 121 °C for 20 minutes

description: Validation of the effectiveness of printed nasal swabs can be found in the Guidelines Section.
